reason: This is a small diff, but it targets `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go` and `pkg/expression/constant.go` to fix a read-write race in instance plan cache. Shared plan-cache state and expression constants sit on a high-blast-radius correctness boundary: a bad concurrency fix here can cause cross-session contamination, stale/mutated constants, wrong-plan reuse, or latent crashes under load. That is central and risky enough to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
